decisions.reason: The format reader and writer plug-ins are a visible product line with their own page that extends the firm's core data integration business, so they are likely to be maintained.
The building digital twin service fits the firm's strategy and market trends, but it is only mentioned on the website, so there is a moderate risk it gets dropped.

The authentication and delegation service overlaps with the identity service and could be absorbed into it, but it costs little to maintain and supports integration, so keeping it remains more likely.
The identity service is actively promoted for seamless integration of GeoIT applications and serves the firm's enterprise integration goals.
The consulting workshop is newly launched with its own page, builds on the firm's consulting expertise and is cheap to offer, so it will likely continue.
